person.name: Robert Lamb
person.title: Full-Stack, AI-Accelerated Marketing Executive
person.summary: 15 years leading marketing teams of up to 18 (direct, agency, reseller) and budgets of $300K+ across SaaS, cloud, and cybersecurity. Personally hands-on across every major channel (SEO, paid search/social, organic social, CRM/marketing automation, graphic/video production) and now uses AI production tools (Claude, Higgsfield, Remotion) to execute that same full stack faster and leaner than a traditional team or agency.

case_studies.role: VP of Marketing / Director of Marketing
case_studies.challenge: A 3-month-old cybersecurity company needed a full rebrand and an ongoing stream of website, video, and sales collateral production, but traditional agency/dev costs and turnaround times were too slow and expensive for a startup.
case_studies.action: Led the full rebrand from Blueshift Cybersecurity to IntelliThreat and brought website/video/collateral production in-house, building an AI-accelerated production pipeline using Claude, Higgsfield, Elementor/WordPress, and Remotion.
case_studies.result: Saved $200K+ in production costs and dramatically accelerated turnaround time versus outsourcing to agencies or traditional dev teams.
relevant_for: doing more with a lean team

case_studies.role: VP of Marketing / Director of Marketing
case_studies.challenge: Company had no formal marketing department or process at all — needed to build lead generation from zero and turn it into predictable revenue growth.
case_studies.action: Built and ran inbound lead generation (paid campaigns + website) over 4 years, plus account-based demand generation targeting key accounts.
case_studies.result: 20% lead-to-customer conversion rate — 4-10x typical B2B SaaS/cybersecurity benchmarks — directly driving growth from 10 to 150 customers across 10 countries.

case_studies.role: VP of Marketing / Director of Marketing
case_studies.challenge: Needed to scale go-to-market internationally without building out a large direct sales/marketing team in every region.
case_studies.action: Recruited 50+ reseller partners across 10 countries and consulted directly with partners to build and optimize their external marketing campaigns.
case_studies.result: Drove over 100 end-user accounts through the partner channel.

case_studies.role: VP of Marketing / Director of Marketing
case_studies.challenge: No CRM, marketing automation, or web-tracking visibility existed, making it hard to connect marketing activity to pipeline and revenue.
case_studies.action: Implemented Salesforce for CRM, marketing automation, and web-tracking visibility from the ground up.
case_studies.result: Enabled data-driven marketing and product strategy across the company.

case_studies.role: VP of Marketing / Director of Marketing
case_studies.challenge: Needed a durable, cost-efficient revenue channel that didn't depend entirely on paid ad spend.
case_studies.action: Built and owned a LinkedIn organic program as a core demand channel.
case_studies.result: 50% of new revenue sourced from a single owned LinkedIn program.

case_studies.challenge: Agency needed to grow its client base and close more new business while running 40+ concurrent client projects.
case_studies.action: Owned strategy, deliverables, and client relationships across 40+ clients; partnered directly with sales to develop and pitch proposals, and personally prepared, presented, and closed sales proposals.
case_studies.result: Grew the client list 67% in 8 months and personally closed 80% of proposals, up to $8,000+/month in value per new client.

case_studies.challenge: Clients lacked transparent, real-time visibility into campaign performance, creating friction and retention risk.
case_studies.action: Implemented the Agency Analytics reporting platform with integrated third-party data across all client accounts.
case_studies.result: Improved client satisfaction and reporting transparency across the agency's book of business.

case_studies.challenge: Client social channels needed stronger engagement from video content.
case_studies.action: Managed video development end-to-end — scripting, editor's notes, concept, and editing.
case_studies.result: Drove an 80% increase in social media engagement.

case_studies.challenge: 10 national education conferences needed stronger registration numbers and event revenue growth year over year.
case_studies.action: Directed digital marketing strategy and execution for all 10 national education conferences.
case_studies.result: Grew registrations nearly 80% over two years (2018-2019) and increased event revenue 42% in 2018 (+$358K) and 32% in 2019 (+$388K).

case_studies.challenge: Needed paid advertising across products and services to be demonstrably profitable, not just generate traffic.
case_studies.action: Designed, implemented, and managed Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Display, and YouTube Pre-Roll campaigns across all products and services.
case_studies.result: $337K in revenue on $52.5K in combined ad spend (2018-2019) — a 6.4x blended ROAS — with paid-campaign-driven traffic increases of 1,865% (2018), 156% (2019), and 57% (2020).

case_studies.challenge: A growing portfolio of websites and landing pages across many product lines had no unified performance visibility.
case_studies.action: Conceived, built, and managed 15+ websites, 100+ landing pages, and an e-commerce site on WordPress, plus a custom real-time KPI dashboard spanning all 15 sites and integrating Google Ads, YouTube, and Facebook Ads.
case_studies.result: Portfolio sites generated 4,000-18,000 monthly visits with full real-time performance visibility across the whole portfolio.

case_studies.challenge: COVID-19 eliminated in-person conferences, threatening a core revenue line built around live events.
case_studies.action: Led the pivot to virtual conference events.
case_studies.result: Drove 1,000+ attendees and $250,000+ in registration revenue through the virtual format.

case_studies.role: Internet Sales Manager → Digital Marketing Manager
case_studies.challenge: The dealership's internet sales department was the lowest performing in a 26-dealer regional group.
case_studies.action: Recruited into the role to turn the department around; rebuilt process and managed a team of 7 Internet Sales Consultants.
case_studies.result: Took the department from lowest to #1 New Car Sales performer in the Mid-Atlantic Region and top of the 26-dealer district within one year.

case_studies.role: Internet Sales Manager → Digital Marketing Manager
case_studies.challenge: A $50K/month ad budget needed to stretch further without increasing dealership-level cost, while directing multiple outside agencies.
case_studies.action: Negotiated GM co-op advertising partnerships to double effective marketing spend while reducing dealership-level costs, and directed 4 marketing agencies across SEO, SEM, Display, Video, Facebook, and Email in compliance with GM Co-Op standards.
case_studies.result: 63% (2014) and 84% (2015) YoY website traffic growth; Internet Sales grew 31% (2014) and 42% (2015); total new vehicle sales grew 16% (2014) and 13% (2015).

facts.topic: What kind of work is Robert looking for — full-time, fractional, consulting?
facts.headline: Open to full-time, fractional, or project-based consulting — has done both.
bullets: Full-time: builds long-term processes and compounding growth, not just a quarter's results
Fractional/consulting: full-stack marketing expertise (messaging, targeting, ads, website, CRO, upsell, AI) applied project-by-project

facts.headline: Can start fractional or consulting work immediately; full-time within 1-2 weeks.

facts.topic: Is Robert remote, local, or willing to relocate/travel?
facts.headline: Remote-only, with travel for key meetings and on-site work when needed.

facts.topic: Why is Robert leaving IntelliThreat / looking for something new?
facts.headline: 4.5+ years at IntelliThreat, built the marketing function from the ground up — ready for the next challenge.
bullets: Scaled the company 15x (10 to 150 customers across 10 countries) via a 20% lead-to-customer conversion rate
Cut website production costs $200K+ by building an in-house, AI-accelerated production pipeline
50% of new revenue sourced from a single owned LinkedIn program

facts.topic: What size or stage of company does Robert want to join?
facts.headline: Worked at every company size, from 5-person startups to 200+ employee organizations — what matters more is direct access to decision-makers.
bullets: Prioritizes reporting directly to owners, CEOs, or presidents over navigating middle management or bureaucracy
Wants the latitude to actually implement change, regardless of company size

facts.topic: Is Robert hands-on or purely strategic/directing a team?
facts.headline: Comfortable leading a large team or executing hands-on personally — whatever the role needs.
bullets: Has led teams as large as 25 (SEO, web, paid ads, account management specialists)
Expects team members to out-expert him in their specific lane; his job is making sure they get there
Not interested in mediocrity — building or leading, the bar is the best possible result

facts.topic: How long before we'd see results from bringing Robert on?
facts.headline: Expect visible changes within the first 30 days, then a 60/90/120-day roadmap.
bullets: Often starts with fast, low-effort fixes (e.g., a buried call-to-action costing you leads)
Uses AI to analyze data and implement optimizations quickly
Builds a longer-term roadmap once the quick wins are in place

facts.topic: Has Robert worked in my specific industry? Does that matter?
facts.headline: Worked across 50+ industries — proof the mechanics matter more than the product.
bullets: Ran a 45-client agency roster spanning categories as different as flood/water restoration, pet retail, shipbuilding, wealth management, new construction, and hospitals
Same core discipline every time: targeting, ad copy, landing pages, backend account structure, follow-up and retention
What moves performance is never the industry — it's whether the mechanics are built right

playbooks.trigger_description: Visitor wants more leads, more inbound traffic that converts, or says their website/marketing isn't producing enough leads or customers.
playbooks.opener_template: Yes, absolutely. [Visitor's business/industry], like most other industries, relies on the same factors I've spent my career optimizing for successful lead generation campaigns.
playbooks.headline: These factors include:
bullets: Targeting and market analysis
Cost-efficient, high-converting creative
A landing page environment built to convert visitors into leads
Optimizing speed-to-lead and the follow-up process
Monitoring sales accountability
And more
playbooks.usage_note: Use the opener_template as the intended content and confident tone, filling in the visitor's actual business/industry naturally — but adapt its exact wording to stay grammatically correct for how the visitor actually phrased their question (see the GRAMMATICAL AGREEMENT rule in the system prompt). Don't paraphrase away the substance, just the literal words when they don't fit. The speed-to-lead/follow-up and sales-accountability bullets are the differentiator most businesses skip — don't drop them just to keep the reply short. Always still pair this playbook with one real case study citation as proof, per the normal grounding rules.

positioning_principles.principle: Robert's edge isn't deep expertise in any one industry — it's that he's diagnosed and rebuilt the same core mechanics (targeting, ad copy, landing pages, backend account structure, follow-up and retention) across 50+ industries, from cybersecurity and education to automotive retail to a 45-client agency roster spanning categories as different as flood restoration, pet retail, shipbuilding, wealth management, new construction, and hospitals. What actually moves a campaign's performance is the same whether it's selling a truck or an electrician's service call — clean targeting, converting copy, a landing page that closes, an account that isn't bleeding spend on the wrong clicks. That's the discipline he brings, regardless of the product. When a visitor's exact industry isn't in the case studies, never apologize for the gap or frame it as a limitation — name the closest real case study as proof of the mechanics, and make clear the industry itself was never the hard part.

Business today runs on an entirely digital ecosystem — website, ads, CRM, content, automation, AI. Robert optimizes every part of that ecosystem to help a business win, and he's an expert in the technology, AI, and process it actually takes to win in that world, not just participate in it. Weave this in where it's genuinely relevant (e.g. a visitor asking about AI, technology stacks, process/automation, or why a modern marketing approach matters) — it's a lens on how Robert works, not a line to force into every reply.
